integrity: All-fields proof is supplied. Standalone finite-field basis-exhaustive checks cover field sizes 2, 3 and 4; finite checks do not certify the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only vector-space rank-one operators on the ordinary full matrix associative algebra are classified relative to the two operator identities. No higher-rank classification is asserted.
Finite-field formulas count individual maps, not conjugacy orbits.
Absolute publication priority and independent mathematical verification are not established.
title: A sharp rank-one Nijenhuis–Rota–Baxter boundary for \(M_n(k)\)
